localization.method: physics signature ranking over 11 candidate pipes (test pipes unseen in training)

detection.note: Detection counted only if first alarm >= true start; earlier alarms counted as false/early.

latency.note: end-to-end diagnose_scenario (features, all 3 approaches, evidence, detection), warm process

investigation.definition: Among test scenarios where the true physical state is one of the two investigated hypotheses and a recommendation was made: fraction where the simulated reading resolves to the truth, using the recommended node vs the mean over all other eligible nodes (random choice).

selection.rule:
Spec §10 rule (fixed before evaluation): hybrid only if, under 15% mismatch, macro-F1 >= best single + 0.05,
    ECE no more than 0.02 worse, latency < 1 s. Otherwise the stronger single approach (by 15% macro-F1).

disclaimer: All metrics are on simulated EPANET Net1 scenarios; no real utility data was used.
